shortDescription: The FTSE MIB Index dropped 276 points or 0.53 percent on Tuesday to close at 52096 points.Losses were led by Poste Italiane (-4.39%), Finecobank (-3.69%) and Telecom Italia (-3.63%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were STMicroelectronics (4.47%), Prysmian (2.72%) and Davide Campari-Milano (1.95%).

children: The FTSE MIB Index dropped 276 points or 0.53 percent on Tuesday to close at 52096 points.

title: The FTSE MIB Index Closes 0.53% Lower
